cases.name: md-link-references
cases.notes: §3.1 step 2: `[t](dest)` → `references`, provenance `link`, src_block = the paragraph.

cases.name: md-link-with-title
cases.notes: A quoted title after the destination is allowed by the pattern.

cases.name: image-embeds
cases.notes: `![alt](dest)` → predicate `embeds`.

cases.name: wikilink-references
cases.notes: §3.1 step 3: `[[note]]` → `references`, target `note` (no extension added).

cases.name: wikilink-alias-is-part-of-target
cases.notes: §8: `[[note|Alias]]` has target `note|Alias`.

cases.name: autolink-external
cases.notes: §3.1 step 4: `<https://…>` → external, provenance `link`, mints `x_0`.

cases.name: bare-url-external
cases.notes: A bare URL at a word boundary → external.

cases.name: bare-url-excluded-after-paren-quote-bracket
cases.notes: §8 lookbehind: a URL right after `(`, `"` or `[` is not a bare URL — and none of these is a link either, so no edge.

cases.name: md-link-to-url-counted-once
cases.notes: `[a](https://…)`: the link scanner owns it (external, `references`); the bare-URL scanner skips it because of the `(`.

cases.name: bare-url-stops-at-space-paren-gt-bracket
cases.notes: The bare URL runs to whitespace, `)`, `>` or `]` — a trailing `.` or `,` is part of it.

items.source: See https://a.com/x. Then https://a.com/y) and https://a.com/z] and https://a.com/w> done https://a.com/v, end

cases.name: heading-anchor
cases.notes: `dest#Heading` → anchor `Heading`, dst_kind document.

cases.name: block-ref-anchor-forced-to-document
cases.notes: `[[note^ref]]` → anchor `ref`; dst_kind is forced to `document` at resolution (§3.2, §8).

cases.name: caret-before-hash
cases.notes: A `^` before any `#` makes a ref: `a^b#c` → path `a`, anchor `b#c`.

cases.name: hash-before-caret
cases.notes: A `#` first makes a heading anchor: `a#b^c` → path `a`, anchor `b^c`.

cases.name: inline-relation-wikilink
cases.notes: §3.1 step 1: `key:: [[t]]` → predicate = src_field = key, provenance `inline_field`; the wikilink is not also a plain link.

cases.name: inline-relation-root-path
cases.notes: `key:: /p.md` → a relation to the root path.

cases.name: inline-relation-url
cases.notes: `key:: https://…` → an external relation.

cases.name: inline-relation-uppercase-key-lowercased
cases.notes: `KEY::` → predicate `key` (case-insensitive match, key lower-cased).

cases.name: inline-relation-plain-text-is-not-an-edge
cases.notes: A plain `key:: text` is a property, not an edge.

cases.name: inline-relation-relative-path-is-not-a-relation
cases.notes: Only `/`-rooted paths, wikilinks and URLs are relation values: `./x.md` yields no edge.

cases.name: inline-relation-mid-line
cases.notes: The key may follow whitespace mid-line, not only at line start.

cases.name: inline-relation-bracketed-is-a-plain-wikilink
cases.notes: `[parent:: [[note]]]`: the key follows `[`, not whitespace, so step 1 does not match and step 3 sees `[[note]]` → `references`.

cases.name: inline-relation-shadows-same-wikilink-in-block
cases.notes: The remembered `[[note]]` suppresses a second, plain `[[note]]` in the same block.

cases.name: inline-relation-shadows-md-link-with-same-destination
cases.notes: The remembered raw value `/p.md` also suppresses `[a](/p.md)` in the same block.

cases.name: inline-relation-does-not-shadow-other-blocks
cases.notes: Remembering is per block: the same wikilink in the next paragraph is a `references` edge.

cases.name: frontmatter-scalar-wikilink
cases.notes: §3.1 frontmatter: a string exactly `[[…]]` → predicate = src_field = key, src_block null, provenance `frontmatter`.

cases.name: frontmatter-root-path
cases.notes: A string starting with `/` is a relation.

cases.name: frontmatter-array
cases.notes: Each array element is considered on its own; a plain string element yields nothing.

cases.name: frontmatter-case-preserved
cases.notes: §8: frontmatter predicates keep their case.

cases.name: frontmatter-relative-is-not-a-relation
cases.notes: `./x.md` is neither `[[…]]` nor `/…`.

cases.name: frontmatter-url-is-not-a-relation
cases.notes: A URL string is not a frontmatter relation (only wikilinks and root paths are).

cases.name: frontmatter-nested-map-not-walked
cases.notes: §8: nested mappings are not walked.

cases.name: frontmatter-with-anchor
cases.notes: Frontmatter destinations are classified like any other: `/a.md#Sec` keeps the anchor.

cases.name: frontmatter-non-string-values-ignored
cases.notes: Numbers, booleans and null yield nothing.

items.source:
---
n: 1
b: true
z: null
---

body

cases.name: dedup-within-block
cases.notes: Two links to one target in one block → one descriptor (first wins); the rollup counts 1.

cases.name: same-target-two-blocks
cases.notes: The same target from two blocks → two edges (different src_block); the rollup counts 2 with both samples.

cases.name: same-target-different-anchors-not-deduped
cases.notes: The anchor is part of the dedup key.

cases.name: same-target-link-and-embed-not-deduped
cases.notes: The predicate is part of the dedup key: `[a](x)` and `![a](x)` are two edges.

cases.name: code-fence-yields-nothing
cases.notes: A `code_fence` block yields no edges; inline code is masked; the real link survives.

cases.name: link-in-list-item-counts-twice
cases.notes: §8 containers: the list and the item each yield a `references` edge; the rollup count is 2.

cases.name: scanner-order-within-a-block
cases.notes: Descriptor order = inline fields, links, wikilinks, autolinks, bare URLs; `x` mints in that order, then every `e`.

items.source: x:: /p.md then [a](/q.md) and [[r]] and <https://s.com> and https://t.com

cases.name: blocks-before-frontmatter
cases.notes: Extraction order: every block, then the frontmatter entries — so the body edge is `e_0`.
